SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "Destination") AS dest_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "Waybill Number") AS n_waybills,
       MIN("Date") AS min_date,
       MAX("Date") AS max_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")) AS n_months
FROM "sheet1";

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "Waybill Number") AS n_waybills,
       SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty,
       ROUND(SUM("List Price Revenue"),2) AS list_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue"),2) AS vas_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Discount Amount"),2) AS discount,
       ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS total_rev,
       ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS wh_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS total_cost,
       ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit
FROM "sheet1"
WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")
ORDER BY month;
